title: Jack Rabbit Custard Doughnut Nic Salt E-Liquid 5mg
description: A rich, squishy and sweet custard doughnut is the sort of indulgent treat we wish we could eat all day. This irresistible e-liquid from Jack Rabbit, however, gives you all the creamy, pastry flavour of a real doughnut but with none of the calories – only super-satisfying all day vaping bliss. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend offers the perfect balance between flavour and cloud production and the nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts with a super-smooth throat hit.
